Daylight spills into a factory workshop beneath an open sky. Seen as a roofless cutaway, its rectangular concrete floor meets concrete walls at the back and on both sides, while the open front faces a loading yard. Two parallel conveyor assembly lines stretch through the workshop, with industrial robotic arms at their sides and control desks marking their ends. A broad central aisle runs between them and continues out into the yard. A boiler, a powder-storage unit, electrical cabinets, and connected metal pipes form a compact utility group against the rear wall. A raised metal platform stands beside this utility equipment, with railings around its edges and an access stair leading up to it. Along one side wall, a storage area holds tall shelving, grouped boxes, pallets, and clusters of barrels. A forklift stands near the shelving; a pallet cart waits by the open front. Concrete pillars mark the workshop's bays, and industrial lamps and signs accompany the work areas. Short stretches of fence trace the loading yard's edges, leaving its entrance open. The concrete and metal bear a worn industrial finish. In the daylight, the two production lines, rear utility zone, side storage, and open circulation routes remain clearly distinguishable.
